mapper.select:
select t1.*from act_hi_procinst t1 left join act_re_procdef t2 on t2.id_ = t1.proc_def_id_ left join act_re_deployment t3 on t3.id_= t2.deployment_id_ left join tbl_flow_extend_procinst t4 on t4.proc_ins_id = t1.proc_inst_id_ left join wf_category t5 on t5.code = t3.category_ left join act_hi_taskinst t6 on t6.proc_inst_id_ = t1.id_ left join act_hi_identitylink t7 on t7.task_id_ = t6.id_ left join sys_user t8 on t8.user_id ::varchar = t7.user_id_
and ( t3.category_ = #{params.category} and ( t7.user_id_ ::varchar = #{params.userId} or t1.start_user_id_ = #{params.userId} OR t7.group_id_ in ( select r.role_id ::varchar from sys_user_role r where r.user_id ::varchar = #{params.userId}) ))
group by t1.id_ order by t1.start_time_

SELECT DISTINCT t1.id_ AS taskId, t2.id_ AS procInsId, t4.id_ AS procDefId, t1.task_def_key_ AS activityId, 'running' AS processStatus, t2.start_user_id_ AS startUserId, t1.name_ AS taskName, t1.create_time_ AS createTime, t4.deployment_id_ AS deployId, t5.code AS category, t5.category_name AS categoryName, t5.url as url, t3.tenant_id as appSn, t3.current_name as startUserName, t1.assignee_ as assigneeId, t6.nick_name as assigneeName, t2.start_act_id_ as startActivityId, t4.name_ as procDefName FROM act_ru_task t1 LEFT JOIN act_hi_procinst t2 ON t1.proc_inst_id_ = t2.id_ LEFT JOIN tbl_flow_extend_procinst t3 ON t3.proc_ins_id = t2.id_ LEFT JOIN act_re_procdef t4 ON t3.proc_def_id = t4.id_ LEFT JOIN wf_category t5 ON t5.code = t4.category_ left join sys_user t6 on t6.user_id ::varchar = t1.assignee_ left join act_re_deployment t7 on t7.id_ = t4.deployment_id_
and t2.id_ = #{procInsId} and t5.code =#{category}
and t1.assignee_ like '%' || #{candidateUser} || '%'
and to_char(t1.create_time_,'%Y-%m') >= to_char(to_date(#{params.beginTime },'yyyy-mm'),'%Y-%m')
and to_char(t1.create_time_,'%Y-%m') <= to_char(to_date(#{params.endTime},'yyyy-mm'),'%Y-%m')
and t4.name_ like '%' || #{processName} || '%'
and t4.key_ =#{processKey}
order by t1.create_time_ desc

SELECT DISTINCT t1.id_ AS taskId, t2.id_ AS procInsId, t4.id_ AS procDefId, t1.task_def_key_ AS activityId, 'completed' AS processStatus, t2.start_user_id_ AS startUserId, t1.name_ AS taskName, t1.start_time_ AS createTime, t1.end_time_ AS finishTime, t4.deployment_id_ AS deployId, t5.code AS category, t5.category_name AS categoryName, t5.url as url, t3.tenant_id as appSn, t3.current_name as startUserName, t1.assignee_ as assigneeId, t6.nick_name as assigneeName, t2.start_act_id_ as startActivityId, t4.name_ as procDefName FROM act_hi_taskinst t1 LEFT JOIN act_hi_procinst t2 ON t1.proc_inst_id_ = t2.id_ LEFT JOIN tbl_flow_extend_procinst t3 ON t3.proc_ins_id = t2.id_ LEFT JOIN act_re_procdef t4 ON t3.proc_def_id = t4.id_ LEFT JOIN wf_category t5 ON t5.code = t4.category_ left join sys_user t6 on t6.user_id ::varchar = t1.assignee_ left join act_re_deployment t7 on t7.id_ = t4.deployment_id_
t1.end_time_ is not null and t2.id_ = #{procInsId} and t5.code =#{category} and (t1.assignee_ like '%' || #{candidateUser} || '%') or t2.start_user_id_ like '%' || #{candidateUser} || '%'
and to_char(t1.start_time_,'%Y-%m') = to_char(to_date(#{params.beginTime },'yyyy-mm'),'%Y-%m')
and to_char(t1.end_time_,'%Y-%m')= to_char(to_date(#{params.endTime},'yyyy-mm'),'%Y-%m')
and t4.name_ like '%' || #{processName} || '%'
and t4.key_ =#{processKey}
order by t1.end_time_ desc
